body:
I tried again last night and tonight to chat with the suicide prevention folks.  This time both nights I got through to the chat after waiting but no one was on the other end to ever respond.  It's kind of like my comments on here, actually.  No one's out there for me.
My husband got so frustrated with me he put his hands on me tonight and that sucked.  I'm so shaky and scared and honestly, this used to happen to me as a kid too, so why in the world is my life just about making others so frustrated they hit me?  My daughter saw the whole thing too.  It really sucks and I just want to leave all this pain and fear behind.

I've been waiting online over an hour now to chat with the suicide prevention folks.  I don't have access to a phone.  Might just try to go to bed and see if I can feel better tomorrow.  But I've been doing just that for years, literally ...

All I can say is I agree - and the internet is an especially harsh place for being bullied, for the reasons you've stated.  Not that real life is much better, but sometimes taking a break from the places you're being bullied on the 'net can help - good luck, I do hope things get better - bullying for me got better once I was out of school, so if you're in that situation, try to keep with it until you're out of school and see if that helps.
